object: Texas Rangers General Manager as of November 20, 2023
belief: Chris Young was the General Manager of the Texas Rangers as of November 20, 2023. He held this position from December 2020 until he was promoted to President of Baseball Operations in late 2024. Ross Fenstermaker was not promoted to GM until November 4, 2024, which is after the cutoff date.

author: worker_2
object: Houston Astros General Manager as of November 20, 2023
belief: Dana Brown was the General Manager of the Houston Astros as of November 20, 2023. He was named GM on January 25, 2023, succeeding James Click.

author: worker_3
object: Atlanta Braves General Manager as of November 20, 2023
belief: Alex Anthopoulos was the General Manager of the Atlanta Braves as of November 20, 2023. He joined the Braves in November 2017 as EVP and GM, was promoted to President of Baseball Operations and GM in February 2020, and held that position through November 2023.

author: worker_4
object: Los Angeles Dodgers General Manager as of November 20, 2023
belief: Brandon Gomes was the General Manager of the Los Angeles Dodgers as of November 20, 2023. He was appointed to the position on January 18, 2022, and held it through November 2023.
